open_points.subject: R0-89 recovery boundary
open_points.text: The restored store begins its own history from the backup: every change after it is lost
open_points.question: Which changes are lost on restore: every change made after the restored backup was created and before the store loss, or some other interval?
options: Changes after the backup timestamp and before the loss are lost
Changes after the store loss are meant, although no store then exists
open_points.default_guess: Every change committed after the restored backup was created and before the store loss is lost.

open_points.subject: import projects with their identity
open_points.text: the import's choices include the names, kinds and tax-id answers given for the Customers it made
open_points.question: When does the owner give these Customer choices, for which imported source records are they required, what values may a “tax-id answer” take, and what missing or invalid choice refuses the import?
options: They are required import inputs for every newly minted Customer
They are required only when a v1 customer reference cannot be classified automatically
They are derived from the export and are not owner inputs
open_points.default_guess: Require explicit name and kind for every newly minted Customer and an explicit decision whether the v1 value is a tax id, validating all choices before applying the atomic import.

open_points.subject: repeating customer actions after re-import
open_points.text: a governance document ... naming each action by ... the `customer_ref` ... A repeated import mints new `customer_ref`s for the Customers it makes
open_points.question: How can an action recorded against a `customer_ref` minted by the lost import be matched to the different `customer_ref` minted by the repeated import?
options: Keep a durable mapping from the v1 source reference to both the lost and replacement `customer_ref`s
Record the v1 source reference alongside each governance action
Reuse the lost minted `customer_ref` on a repeated import
Require the owner to identify the Customer manually
open_points.default_guess: Keep a durable source-reference-to-minted-reference mapping with the retained import choices and use it to translate recorded actions.

open_points.subject: retention-review recovery record
open_points.text: What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship, the greatest date audit entries were ever erased by — follows the owner's record of the retention review
open_points.question: Must the record also preserve and replay inverse actions such as lifting a restriction and resuming a relationship, and if several actions affected the same record, in what order are they replayed?
options: Record and replay every apply/lift and end/resume action in chronological order
Record only the final restriction and relationship state
Repeat only the listed one-way actions and let the owner repair inverse changes from memory
open_points.default_guess: Record every state-changing action, including lifts and resumptions, and replay them in their original order.

open_points.subject: audit-erasure recovery record
open_points.text: naming each action by its date, kind ... — an audit erasure by its date alone
open_points.question: For an audit erasure, does “its date” mean the date the action occurred or the cutoff supplied to “erase audit entries before a date”?
options: The date the erasure action occurred
open_points.default_guess: Record the cutoff date, because that is the input needed to repeat the erasure.

open_points.subject: R0-80 one-home rule
open_points.text: The kept export and the import's choices hold personal data ... the owner keeps them in the vault
open_points.question: Is this vault-held migration material a temporary exception to R0-80, which says personal data is held only by Registry and admits only issued documents and Client Portal's offline projection as kept copies?
options: Add the vault-held migration material as a named temporary exception
Define the one-home rule as applying only to operational service stores
Remove personal values from the retained material
open_points.default_guess: Treat the vault-held migration material as an explicit temporary exception lasting only until a checked backup holds the import.
